delivery.note: Conditions are evaluated on every run against the latest data. Dispatch to an email or SMS channel is not implemented: it needs a provider credential and a recipient list, both of which are the practice partner's to supply.

exchange_rate.source: Turkish central bank daily reference rate

signals.reasoning: Local conversion costs rise with the wage increase, so current price levels will not hold.

opportunity.basis: annual volume 600 t x current price, three-month trend extrapolated over 6 months

forecast.method: three-month trend extrapolation, band = historical volatility x sqrt(month)

signals.negotiation_argument: The Turkish minimum wage increase of 15% will directly raise local conversion costs, so current price levels will not hold. With the monthly price trend already up by 1.18% on average, delaying the decision by six months would add about EUR 49,600 to the annual volume. Secure the purchase now to lock in the current EUR 1.17 per kg before these cost pressures push prices higher.

signals.reasoning: Freight costs are surging and will feed into local list prices with a delay.

opportunity.basis: annual volume 1,300 t x current price, three-month trend extrapolated over 6 months

forecast.method: three-month trend extrapolation, band = historical volatility x sqrt(month)

signals.negotiation_argument: The PA6 price trend has been falling by 0.86 percent monthly, which would normally justify waiting, but the Red Sea shipping disruption is pushing freight costs up by 20 percent, and this will feed into local list prices with a delay. Buying now locks in the current EUR 2.64 per kg and avoids the risk of absorbing higher costs on the annual volume of EUR 3,432,000. Secure the order immediately, before the freight surcharge is reflected in supplier quotes.

signals.reasoning: Market volatility is extreme, so committing now risks buying at a peak.

opportunity.basis: annual volume 5,000 t x current price, three-month trend extrapolated over 6 months

forecast.method: three-month trend extrapolation, band = historical volatility x sqrt(month)

signals.negotiation_argument: The geopolitical supply disruption risk is severe and could drive costs far beyond the current upward trend, so committing now risks buying at a peak. Although the price has risen by 1.05 percent monthly on average, the extreme volatility means waiting is the safer course. We should therefore delay the purchase decision by six months, as acting now would expose us to an extra cost of about EUR 246,230 on the annual volume if prices spike.
